    • 字段详细资料

      • aliUid

        @NameInMap(value="AliUid")
public Long aliUid

        The ID of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

        example:

        22973492****

      • confirmFlag

        @NameInMap(value="ConfirmFlag")
public Boolean confirmFlag

        Indicates whether the notification has been received. This indicates whether the ConfirmNotify operation was called to mark the notification as confirmed. Valid values:

        • true: Yes.
        • false: No.
        example:

        true

      • confirmor

        @NameInMap(value="Confirmor")
public Long confirmor

        The UID of the user who received the notification under the current Alibaba Cloud account. This user called the ConfirmNotify operation to mark the notification as confirmed.

        A value of 0 indicates that the notification was automatically received by the system.

        example:

        0

      • gmtCreated

        @NameInMap(value="GmtCreated")
public String gmtCreated

        The time when the notification was created.

        example:

        2022-04-21T02:04:04Z

      • gmtModified

        @NameInMap(value="GmtModified")
public String gmtModified

        The time when the notification was modified.

        example:

        2022-04-21T02:10:47Z

      • id

        @NameInMap(value="Id")
public Long id

        The notification ID.

        example:

        103499

      • idempotentCount

        @NameInMap(value="IdempotentCount")
public String idempotentCount

        The number of times that duplicate notifications were blocked.

        example:

        0

      • idempotentId

        @NameInMap(value="IdempotentId")
public String idempotentId

        The ID used to ensure the idempotence of the notification and prevent duplicate notifications.

        example:

        ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCz****

      • level

        @NameInMap(value="Level")
public String level

        The level of the notification. Valid values:

        • help: Help level.
        • success: Success level.
        • warning: Warning level.
        • error: Error level.
        • loading: In progress.
        • notice: Notice level.
        example:

        error

      • notifyElement

        @NameInMap(value="NotifyElement")
public String notifyElement

        The elements in the notification template, which consist of a JSON string. The parameters contained in the JSON string vary based on the TemplateName.

        • If TemplateName is RenewalRecommend:
          • instanceName: the ID of the instance that is about to expire.
          • reservedTime: the number of remaining days.
        • If TemplateName is InstanceCreateFailed:
          • orderId: the order ID for purchasing the instance.
          • reason: the reason why the instance failed to be created.
        example:

        {\"orderId\":21466****}

      • templateName

        @NameInMap(value="TemplateName")
public String templateName

        The notification template. Valid values:

        • RenewalRecommend: Renewal recommendation.
        • InstanceCreateFailed: Instance creation failure and refund.
        example:

        InstanceCreateFailed

      • type

        @NameInMap(value="Type")
public String type

        The notification type. Valid values:

        • Sell: Sales notification.
        • Operation: O&M notification.
        • Promotion: Promotional notification.
        example:

        Sell
